Partners-Eng: Heads up - Nimbus Health SI deployment has hit a stack of blockers. Need a quick architecture review + a staged fallback plan. Customer wants marketplace listing + on-prem private deployment coordinated.
Laura (SE): ✅ I can run the arch review. When's the desired go-live?
Samir (Customer): target is May 4 for internal launch, public announcement TBD, but we need certs and network cleared this week.
Partners-Eng: primary blockers: 1) Aurora Systems NIC driver mismatch causing perf regressions on our quantized kernels, 2) customer firewall only allows outbound 443 and a few whitelisted IPs, 3) compliance needs audit logs enabled for private deploy.
Ajay (Runtime): For the driver issue we can: fallback to older kernel variant (v1.8) or use a CPU-backed Dedicated pool as short-term. Suggest canary weighting: 10% older kernel, 90% default on dedicated for first 24h.
Kevin (Infra): For networking we need the exact IP ranges and ports. Samir, can you confirm if the firewall supports static egress IPs or only dynamic?
Samir (Customer): firewall supports static ranges only. We'll need a list of IPs to request from infra.
Laura (SE): Copying minimal port list for Redwood Private control plane and health checks: ```
- TCP 443 outbound to control-plane.redwood.example:443
- TCP 123 (ntp) outbound to ntp.pool.example
- TCP 22 to bastion only for ops support (optional)
```
Partners-Eng: add the marketplace health probe for the listing: port 8443 from partner-marketplace IPs.
Kevin (Infra): I'll prepare a CIDR list. Also flag: if we route through the customer's NAT, we may lose source IPs for audit logs. Need to plan for KMS/HSM key access and log shipping.
Ajay (Runtime): For audit logs we can enable streaming to the customer's syslog endpoint; also we can emit token-level anonymized traces to S3 for compliance. Laura, does Nimbus have a logging collector?
Laura (SE): They use Splunk Cloud. We'll add an event forwarder in the runbook.
Partners-Eng: Action items: 1) Kevin - produce static IP CIDRs by EOD (1951239000) 2) Ajay - prepare canary rollout plan and fallback to cpu/dedicated (include percent and TTL) 3) Laura - schedule 60m arch review w/ Nimbus and Aurora (propose two windows) 4) Samir - request firewall exception once IPs provided.
Kevin (Infra): noted. I'll share CIDRs and a brief NAT/port diagram.
Ajay (Runtime): Canary plan draft: traffic split 10/90 for 24h, automatic rollback after 2 consecutive 5m error spikes, metrics: p99 latency > 2s or error rate > 1% triggers. Will follow up with config snippet.
Oncall-Bot: deploy-checker: Canary policy applied to cluster redwood-dedicated-03 at 1951239800 - no anomalies observed in first 30m.
Samir (Customer): thanks team. Also want to align press timing with marketplace listing. Can we avoid announcing until 48h post go-live?
Laura (SE): yes, we'll coordinate. Partners-Eng can own the announcement window.
Partners-Eng: I'll coordinate with marketing after we confirm go-live SLA. For now, team sync tomorrow 9am PT. Quick question for the arch review doc - should I include the hardware firmware matrix and driver fallback steps?
Ajay (Runtime): include firmware matrix + exact quantization kernels used. That avoids surprises.
Kevin (Infra): include a snippet for NAT hairpin and syslog endpoint config: ```
syslog.server: splunk-nimbus.example:514
egress.cidr: ["35.244.128.0/20", "34.72.0.0/16"]
```
Laura (SE): booked arch review invite for tomorrow 9am PT with Nimbus and Aurora. Agenda: network, drivers, canary, compliance, marketplace health.
Partners-Eng: perfect. I'll send a pre-read with the canary plan and required IP ranges. :thumbsup:
Samir (Customer): appreciated, see you tomorrow.
Partners-Eng: closing loop here post-review — will post follow-ups in this thread.
